data.body:
[P2] Continue advancing after an expired runner’s deadline

An abandoned child can run a never-settling step alongside a one-hour durable wait while its caller subsequently waits two hours. After the hold expires, this selects the child’s one-hour deadline. `applyDeadline()` queues an invocation behind the stuck invocation, so that queued invocation never runs. Processing the wait’s completion does not call `advance()`, and the expired hold schedules no further timer. Consequently, the caller’s remaining hour takes real time and its test times out. Arrange another coordinator pass after applying a deadline owned by a still-running invocation whose hold has expired, preserving the busy checks for runnable invocations. Add an integration regression combining a stuck child step, the child’s own wait, and a later caller deadline.
